• The money market remained fairly stable in 1H 2018.
• The yields on short term government paper have not
significantly moved during the last few months. Interest rate
on 91-days, 182-days and 364-days Treasury bills were 7.7%,
9.6% and 10.5%, respectively at the close of 2Q2018
compared to 8.3%, 10.3% and 10.9%, respectively for 2Q
2017.
• The average interbank rate also fell to 5.3% in 1H2018
compared to 5.5% in 1H2017 indicating higher liquidity in the
banking sector.
• Private sector credit growth has started picking up. It grew
at 2.8% in the month April 2018 (yoy) compared to 2.2% in
April 2017.
